blocks.title: Records group fields
blocks.text: A record represents one entity using several related fields. In C#, this positional record creates a named Student type with properties. Those properties use init, so use a with expression to create an updated copy.

blocks.title: Lists can change size
blocks.text: A list is ordered like an array, but its size can change while the program runs.

blocks.title: Tuples group a few values
blocks.text: A tuple groups values without declaring a reusable Student type. It is especially helpful when a method returns several results.

blocks.title: Choose by behaviour
blocks.text: The exam may ask why one structure suits a context better than another.
